shortDescription: Uploads a configuration onto the AOS-CX switch.

options.name: config_file
options.description: File name and path for locally uploading configuration, only JSON version of configuration can be uploaded.

options.name: config_json
options.description: JSON file name and path for locally uploading configuration, only JSON version of configuration can be uploaded.

options.name: config_name
options.description: Switch config file to be uploaded to, only running-config or startup-config can be used

options.name: remote_config_file_tftp_path
options.description: TFTP server address and path for uploading configuration, can be JSON or CLI format, must be reachable through provided vrf.

options.name: vrf
options.description: VRF to be used to contact TFTP server, required if remote_output_file_tftp_path is provided.
